zh.text: 阿尔吉侬是一只为科学献身的聪明老鼠，他有短暂而璀璨的一生，主人公查理也是。
这本书的翻译非常困难也很有趣，并且这一版的翻译我觉得超好，分享给大家。

zh.alt: 有趣的谐音，模仿初学者学习说话。
进步报告=日记，看起来“我”很有进步了，我们也要坚持写日记。
必须停止像小孩一样不断为自己忧虑。

en.text: Algernon is a clever mouse who gave his life for the sake of science; he lived a brief yet brilliant life—as did the protagonist, Charlie.
Translating this book was both extremely challenging in Chinese and highly engaging; I personally think this particular translation is excellent, so I’m sharing it with you all.

en.alt: Playful puns that mimic a beginner learning to speak.
A progress report is like a diary; it seems "I" have made a lot of progress—we should also keep a diary.
We must stop constantly worrying about yourself like a child.
